frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.title: Defining the Scope of Your Web Development Project
frontmatter.subheading: A Guide to the Project Scope of Work: Stop Guessing and Start Defining
frontmatter.excerpt: Stop project creep before it kills your budget. This guide breaks down how to build a brutal, honest, and effective Project Scope of Work (SOW) for web development, covering deliverables, timelines, and the hidden risks most agencies ignore.
